The '''Delemede system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delemede/Legends|Delemede]].
